capabilities: show inline ghost-text thinking prompts at the cursor
switch between suggestion modes (questions, structural, critical, connector)
trigger suggestions automatically after pauses or manually via command
configure API endpoint, model, context size, and trigger delay
disambiguation: Unlike autocomplete plugins, it does not complete your text; it suggests what to think about next.
extras: Privacy note: limited note content is sent to the configured API endpoint; keys are stored locally in the vault.
intentEvidence: Inspired by IDE code completion and the obsidian-copilot-auto-completion plugin architecture.
problem: Obsidian AI helpers generate text for you, but nothing nudges your own thinking with questions and prompts while you write.

relations.evidence: Inspired by IDE code completion and the obsidian-copilot-auto-completion plugin architecture.

requires.name: API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Ollama or LM Studio (local OpenAI-compatible providers)

summary: AI thinking companion that shows faded ghost-text prompts at your cursor suggesting what to think or write about next, without writing content for you.
